content.short: Meridian offers mutualized perpetuals on Robinhood Chain for capital-efficient global markets.
content.description: Meridian trades what it calls mutualized perpetuals on Robinhood Chain, a design intended to share liquidity across markets so that each individual market does not need its own depth to function. On a chain listing many tokenized equities, that shared model addresses the obvious problem: most individual stocks will never attract enough liquidity on their own.
